items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 24:1
items.html: Because the new Mah emerged upon the screen of Nekudim after it was refined, as is known, and the entire root of Nekudim is from the navel of AK downward, for above the navel is the aspect of Akudim, as is known. (Inner Light, p. 606, entry "And the light")
